Package index

Workflow

Main poly(A) quantification workflow

Load.PolyA()
Load raw poly(A) site data
Remove.IP()
Remove IP
Cluster.PolyA()
Generate PACs
Annotate.PolyA()
Annotate the PACs
Filter.PolyA()
Filter out PACs

APA dynamics

Quantify.SplitAPA()
Quantify APA dynamics among split PACs
Quantify.CanonicalAPA()
Quantify APA dynamics among canonical PACs
Quantify.CNCAPA()
Quantify the APA dynamics between canonical and non-canonical PACs in a gene.
Quantify.GeneAPA()
Quantify the APA dynamics across a whole gene

Visualization and statistics

Visualize.PolyA()
Visualize poly(A) profiles
DESeq2.PolyA()
Perform basic differential expression analysis using DESeq2 package

Classes and low-level functions

QuantifyPolyA-class
Class QuantifyPolyA.
show(<QuantifyPolyA>)
Method show.
is.internal.priming()
Check whether the poly(A) sites are resulted from internal priming artifacts or not.
polyAsite.annotation()
Annotate the poly(A) sites based on the genomic structures
buildGenomicRanges()
Construct genomic ranges
simpleCluster()
Cluster poly(A) sites into groups by a certain distance iterative.
findPeaks()
Cluster the one-dimensional poly(A) sites into groups based on local density
dynamicsDetect()
Detect APA dynamics between two samples
FU()
Calculate the Pearson correlation coefficient of two PAC vectors.
Motif.Search()
Motif search
